subject: Annual prepay — ledger cadence, remit template & VAT evidence request
messages:
From: Rupert Hayes <rupert@brightline.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Annual prepay — ledger cadence and VAT evidence

Hi Logan (and team),

Thanks again for the walk-through last week. We’re ready to lock the annual prepay for the $1.2M committed spend (FY27). Before procurement signs, AP needs two things from Redwood so our treasury team can wire and schedule the drawdowns:

1) A simple drawdown ledger template that shows tranche dates, invoice numbers, and remaining balance per tranche. We prefer a CSV for easy upload to our ERP.
2) A checklist of the VAT/tax evidence you will provide for each tranche (in Brightline’s jurisdiction we need the invoice + VAT proof or exemption references).

Can you send the CSV sample and confirm whether we should expect monthly micro-invoices or quarterly tranche invoices? Also include the preferred remit format (ACH vs wire) and the exact payee/legal entity name for the invoice header so our AP can map it.

We’d like to get the first tranche cleared by Sept 10 to hit our forecast.

Attachments: drawdown-ledger-template.csv (CSV stub)

Best,
Rupert Hayes
Finance Manager, Brightline Analytics
rupert@brightline.com

--
Brightline Finance (AP): finance@brightline.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Rupert Hayes <rupert@brightline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 17:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — ledger cadence and VAT evidence

Hi Rupert — thanks, this is straightforward. Quick summary / proposal from our side: 

- Invoice phasing: we recommend quarterly tranche invoices (4x) for a $1.2M prepay to reduce per-invoice admin, with a monthly internal drawdown ledger we can provide for your ERP. Each tranche invoice will include the tranche amount, trailing remaining committed balance, and a tranche invoice number.
- Drawdown ledger: attached is a sample CSV (drawdown-ledger-template.csv) with the columns we usually export: invoice_date, invoice_number, tranche_amount_usd, balance_after_tranche_usd, vat_amount, currency, remit_entity.
- VAT evidence: we will supply a cover PDF for each tranche that includes: Redwood invoice PDF, Redwood VAT registration (where applicable), and the VAT calculation table. If a jurisdiction requires exemption paperwork we’ll note that on the ledger.
- Remit/payee: Redwood Inference, Inc. — Bank details will be provided via our payment-remit-template.xlsx (we do not include full bank details in email; will share on the DocuSign/secure doc link).

Action items: can AP confirm preferred invoice delivery: (A) PDF emailed to finance@brightline.com + AP portal upload OR (B) single SFTP delivery of tranche PDFs + CSV? Also confirm desired currency (USD or EUR) and whether we should convert on invoice date or fix FX up front.

I’ll loop in Kimberly and Jonas to confirm tax evidence path for EU/UK if any of the tranches route through those entities.

Attachments: drawdown-ledger-template.csv (CSV), payment-remit-template.xlsx (secure stub)

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rupert Hayes <rupert@brightline.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — ledger cadence and VAT evidence

Hi all,

Quick clarifications from tax/finance ops:

- VAT handling: because Brightline is US-headquartered, for the US-tranche our invoices will show $0 VAT and reference the US tax stance. If any invoices are routed to EU/UK entities we will append the VAT summary and provide the supplier VAT registration card.
- Invoice timing: Redwood can issue tranche invoices on the first business day of the quarter. The internal drawdown CSV will be pushed daily to an S3 bucket (read-only) and we can provide a signed one-off access token for your ERP team to pull the CSV each morning.
- Evidence package: We’ll attach a single PDF per tranche that bundles (1) invoice PDF, (2) VAT registration screenshot (if relevant), and (3) a short reconciliation table.

We prefer the SFTP/S3 route (option B) for operational scale — reduces manual email handling and prevents AP duplicates. If you cannot accept S3, we’ll send via secure DocuSign link for bank routing.

Jonas — can you prepare the sample S3 path + token and send to rupert@brightline.com?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Finance Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Rupert Hayes <rupert@brightline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — ledger cadence and VAT evidence

Hi Rupert — I created a short-lived S3 token and a sample export path for the drawdown ledger: s3://redwood-prepay-exports/brightline/BR-2026-78321/drawdown-ledgers/2026-Q4-sample.csv (access token expires in 7 days). I’ll send the token in a separate secure email to finance@brightline.com and will not paste credentials here.

Also included a small automation note: we can emit a webhook to your accounting system on tranche invoice generation (payload includes invoice_number, invoice_date, tranche_amount_usd, balance_after_tranche_usd, vat_amount, remit_entity). If you’d like that enabled, tell us the receiving endpoint and authentication method and we’ll schedule the integration for a 2-week turnaround.

Attached: VAT-evidence-request.pdf (templated checklist)

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Billing & Collections, Redwood Inference
From: Rupert Hayes <rupert@brightline.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, AP Team <finance@brightline.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 10:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — ledger cadence and VAT evidence

Thanks — all, this is perfect and aligns with our procurement checklist. Two quick confirmations:

1) We’ll take S3 delivery + the CSV pull and will ask our treasury to expect quarterly tranche invoices on 2026-10-04, 2027-01-03, 2027-04-01, 2027-07-01.
2) Please send the DocuSign envelope for the wiring addendum (so our Treasury can approve the payout setup). HubSpot has been updated with the contract record: HS-78321.

If the webhook is available, please add basic HMAC auth and a retry window of 1 hour — we’ll provide an endpoint next week.

I’ll queue our AP to expect the secure token email from Jonas. Once we confirm the DocuSign, we’ll issue the first tranche payment.

Appreciate the speed — Rupert
Rupert Hayes
Finance Manager, Brightline Analytics
